fi.character.awareness.why: the most self-transparent seat in the stack: the tone is always audible
fi.character.control.why: steerable up to the line a value draws; immovable past it
fi.character.endurance.why: conviction is effortless and constant — holding the standard costs nothing
fi.character.precision.why: the hierarchy of what matters is deep, calm, and exact
fi.character.speed.why: deep and still — the verdict is total, and rarely fast
fi.energy.recovery.dominant: Refills in minutes — and partially during use (flow).
fi.energy.recovery.inferior: The hangover shelf: ~30 min where the whole system runs dim.
fi.energy.recovery.shadow: Incomplete — some of the charge simply doesn't come back today.
fi.energy.recovery.tertiary: A slower refill; rest must be deliberate.

fi.feeder.ne.figure: The nebula spreads wide, mist drifting into branching plumes.
fi.feeder.ne.mechanism: Ne — extraverted intuition, the auxiliary here — delivers forking possibilities, and each is struck against the inner standard: could I live with this? who would I be in that world? Many futures are held lightly at once, waiting to see which rings true.

fi.feeder.ni.figure: Long stillness, then the whole nebula re-colours at once.
fi.feeder.ni.mechanism: Ni — introverted intuition — sends few experiences, each already condensed into a single meaning. Fi gets little to weigh and much to absorb, re-ranking what it cares about around each arrival. No standard stack places Ni directly above Fi; this coupling is the site's own thought experiment.

fi.feeder.se.figure: The nebula draws tight and saturated, dense around what is present.
fi.feeder.se.mechanism: Se — extraverted sensing — delivers the vivid, concrete present, and Fi weighs what is actually here in front of it. Judgement lives in the hands and eyes: taste, beauty, and right action felt directly rather than argued.

fi.feeder.si.figure: The mist circles the core in closed rings — nothing entering, nothing leaving.
fi.feeder.si.mechanism: Si — introverted sensing, the INFP's tertiary — replays stored experience instead of gathering new. Old wounds and old kindnesses are re-felt against the same standard, verdicts renewed instead of re-tested. This is the loop, seen from inside.
fi.feeder.si.pair: the loop coupling (Fi–Si, INFP under stress)

fi.feeder.te.figure: The emitter glows, but the mist has nothing to close around.
fi.feeder.te.mechanism: Te — extraverted thinking — is a judging function, so it hands over verdicts about efficiency rather than lived experience. Fi receives almost nothing it can weigh and idles hungry. Real stacks alternate judging with perceiving precisely so something is always gathering material.

fi.fieldNotes.mirror.figure: Same element, opposite attitudes: one instrument tuned to the room, one to its own note.
fi.fieldNotes.mirror.mechanismHtml: Where Fe reads the emotional tone of the room and builds social harmony, Fi reads the emotional tone of the self and builds personal integrity. Fe trades individual preference for group unity; Fi trades group approval for internal truth.

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.accusation.figure: Refusing to tint the mist to match the room.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.accusation.mechanism: The charge arrives sooner or later, usually mid-negotiation, usually from someone fluent in Fe. What is actually happening: Fi will not counterfeit agreement, and in a room that trades on visible accord, declining to fake it reads as defection. The refusal is not carelessness — an unfaked yes is the one thing Fi thinks worth paying anyone in, and it is priced accordingly.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.accusation.title: "Selfish"

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.figure: A dim core flaring all at once.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.mechanism: An ESTJ under prolonged stress breaks into overwhelming, wounded moralising — accusations of betrayal and heartlessness delivered with an intensity that startles everyone. This is the grip: a spent dominant handing control to inferior Fi, which erupts with none of a practised Fi's proportion.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.title: The Inferior Eruption

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.lockedDrawer.figure: A small nebula behind frosted glass.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.lockedDrawer.mechanism: Tertiary Fi in an ISTJ is a private moral ledger under a procedural exterior: the one client they will not take, the one joke that ends a friendship, the standing donation nobody hears about — commitments held for decades and explained, if pressed, as "just how I do things." The values are real; the vocabulary for them was never built.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.lockedDrawer.title: The Locked Drawer

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.figure: The mist circles in closed rings — tender, airless, sealed.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.mechanism: Under stress, an INFP's dominant Fi pairs with tertiary Si and replays old wounds and old kindnesses against the same inner standard — verdicts re-felt instead of re-tested. Both functions face inward, so nothing in the pair can interrupt it: the pattern typology forums call a loop.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.title: The Loop

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.mediation.figure: One core cannot average two others.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.mediation.mechanism: Ask Fi to chair a compromise between two parties it finds both partly wrong, and the instrument jams. It evaluates everything against one inner standard and has no native operation for splitting the difference between other people's. It can do the job — through principle, at cost — while the table mistakes its silence for assent and its verdicts for stubbornness. This is Fe's home ground; Fi visits on foreign plates.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.mediation.title: The Mediation

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForNoOpin.mechanism: Weeks of amiable flexibility about restaurants, plans, and process — then a line is crossed and a verdict arrives whole, final, and non-negotiable. The tell that separates this from mere agreeableness: the position was settled long before the meeting, in private. Fe negotiates its stance in the room; Fi's stance predates the room, and the room is simply the last to find out.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForNoOpin.title: Mistaken for No Opinion

fi.fieldNotes.vignette.silentCompass.figure: The core does not argue; it just holds its colour.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.silentCompass.mechanism: An INFP sits quietly in a meeting where everyone agrees on a compromise. Then they say no — not loudly, not with a ten-point argument, but with a firmness that stops the room. The position was settled long before anyone spoke; the meeting is only just finding out.
fi.fieldNotes.vignette.silentCompass.title: The Silent Compass

fi.hero.heading: The Architecture of {fn}
fi.hero.subtitle: A quiet nebula around a core tone — weighing every experience against an unargued inner compass.
fi.lab.btn.authBad.label: Experience authentic grief
fi.lab.btn.authGood.label: Experience authentic joy
fi.lab.btn.fakeBad.label: Witness an inauthentic violation
fi.lab.btn.fakeGood.label: Hear an inauthentic pleasantry

fi.lab.narration.authBad.figure: The mist slows, darkens, and holds it, deep in the nebula.
fi.lab.narration.authBad.mechanism: Something painful — and true. Fi does not deflect it: the grief is absorbed and held, because for this function rightness outranks comfort. Stress rises, and so does the sense of being intact — this, too, will shape the standard.

fi.lab.narration.authGood.figure: It rings against the core and diffuses deep — the mist turns gently, and the whole nebula warms toward what was taken in.
fi.lab.narration.authGood.mechanism: Something joyful — and true — arrives. Fi takes it all the way in: the experience is absorbed rather than just noticed, and it recolours the standard a little. What is genuinely loved becomes part of how everything else gets weighed.

fi.lab.narration.fakeBad.figure: It tears straight through the nebula — mist churns away from its path, a vacuum dragging behind —
fi.lab.narration.fakeBad.mechanism: A falsehood strikes something that matters. This is the one event Fi cannot file quietly: a violation of the standard demands a response from the whole system.

fi.lab.narration.fakeBadEnd.figure: …the mist stills and the colour steadies.
fi.lab.narration.fakeBadEnd.mechanism: The wound closes and the standard has changed shape — darker in places, rearranged in others. Fi keeps what was real and remembers where it bled.

fi.lab.narration.fakeBadMid.figure: — some of the mist bleeds out through the wound, and the whole field red-shifts.
fi.lab.narration.fakeBadMid.mechanism: Holding the violation costs real substance: everything attached to the wounded value has to find a new place around it.

fi.lab.narration.fakeGood.figure: The mist refuses to mix with it…
fi.lab.narration.fakeGood.mechanism: Flattery arrives — pleasant, glossy, and hollow. It fails the authenticity test on contact, so there is nothing to absorb: Fi cannot be paid in counterfeit.

fi.lab.narration.fakeGoodEnd.figure: …it glides along the inside walls, dissolving nothing, and is shown out exactly as it came.
fi.lab.narration.fakeGoodEnd.mechanism: The pleasantry is tolerated politely and released unchanged. Nothing was kept; nothing needed to be. What never rang true was never really in the room.

fi.lab.narration.intro: Click a button to send Fi an experience, and watch it absorb, hold, reject, or bleed around what arrives.
fi.meta.title: Fi — Introverted Feeling · CURRENTS

fi.slot.auxiliary.example: An ENFP chases a new project for a fortnight, then drops it in an afternoon when it would mean flattering someone they despise.
fi.slot.auxiliary.figure: The nebula renders smaller, brightening when a check is called for.
fi.slot.auxiliary.mechanism: In the second seat, Fi is consulted rather than continuously running: it vets what the dominant perceiving function brings home — is this us? could I live with this? — quietly in the background, and decisively at exactly the moments that matter. Between verdicts it stays out of the way.

fi.slot.critical.example: An ISFJ spends a sleepless hour questioning whether their grief is really about the loss or about themselves.
fi.slot.critical.figure: Cold eddies cross the nebula, thinning the mist where they pass.
fi.slot.critical.mechanism: In the sixth seat, Fi turns inward as an interrogator of the heart: do you even know what you want? aren't these feelings self-indulgent? The audits are sporadic and harsh, aimed mostly at the self, and better at doubting a value than at building one.

fi.slot.demon.example: At 3 a.m. an INTP is suddenly, wordlessly certain that everyone who ever liked them was mistaken.
fi.slot.demon.figure: The core inverts — a dark star pulling the mist in instead of lighting it.
fi.slot.demon.mechanism: The eighth seat runs rarest and worst. When it erupts — usually at the bottom of a long bad stretch — it produces total moral certainty aimed inward: a conviction of worthlessness or betrayal presenting itself as plain fact. It is the least practised seat in the stack, not a verdict.

fi.slot.dominant.example: Asked why they turned the offer down, an INFP says "it wasn't right" — and is correct, and cannot say more for a week.
fi.slot.dominant.figure: CURRENTS draws this as a nebula at full glow — a steady core, mist turning calmly around it.
fi.slot.dominant.mechanism: In the first seat, Fi evaluates everything against a felt inner standard of what matters, and the evaluation runs continuously at almost no cost. Verdicts arrive without argument attached — knowing comes first, explaining later, if at all. The price is portability: the standard is precise but hard to show to anyone else.

fi.slot.inferior.example: An ENTJ mid-crisis announces, to a stunned meeting, that nobody here has ever appreciated them.
fi.slot.inferior.figure: A dim nebula with a flickering core — long quiet, then sudden weather.
fi.slot.inferior.mechanism: In the fourth seat, Fi costs the most per use and gets used least. Day to day, feelings are treated as noise in the data; under prolonged stress the seat can seize control and produce wounded, moralising sentiment that does not sound like them — the eruption Quenk calls the grip.

fi.slot.opposing.example: An ESFJ who has absorbed complaints all evening abruptly refuses one, on principle, and will not be moved.
fi.slot.opposing.figure: Below the rail's waterline the nebula stiffens, mist bristling instead of turning.
fi.slot.opposing.mechanism: The fifth seat opens the shadow — the four positions a person runs rarely, and mostly without noticing. Here Fi wakes contrary: when the person's usual Fe harmonising is challenged, a personal stand appears — "I don't care what the room needs, this is where I stand" — protective, prickly, and briefly immovable.

fi.slot.tertiary.example: An ISTJ has quietly funded a cause for twenty years and calls it "just a standing order."
fi.slot.tertiary.figure: A small nebula, dense at the middle, almost opaque from outside.
fi.slot.tertiary.mechanism: In the third seat, Fi is real but narrow and mostly private: fierce loyalty to a few people and principles, rarely explained and often disguised as practicality. It strengthens with age, and under stress it can pair with the dominant function into a closed circuit no outside view corrects — the pattern called a loop.
fi.slot.tertiary.note: Tertiary role and pacing follow the Grant model; the loop is community vocabulary.

fi.slot.trickster.example: Asked what they actually want, an ENTP builds three funny arguments for three incompatible answers and picks none.
fi.slot.trickster.figure: The nebula refuses to settle on a colour — it mirrors whatever is aimed at it.
fi.slot.trickster.mechanism: In the seventh seat, being asked what one truly feels registers as a trap. The person deflects with charm or contrarian play, and genuinely cannot tell a value from a preference from the inside — the blindness is real, not strategic, and there is no malice in it.

fi.zoneA.canvasAria: Interactive visual representation of Introverted Feeling as a luminous nebula
fi.zoneB.heading: The Eight Faces of Fi
fi.zoneB.lede: The canvas draws Fi as a nebula around a core: every experience that enters is weighed against one inner tone. Where Fi sits in a person's stack — the fixed order their eight functions come in — changes how that weighing runs. Click a position to see the change, and drag the maturity slider to watch the lower seats gain fidelity with age.
fi.zoneC.heading: What Feeds Into Fi?
fi.zoneC.lede: Fi judges; it does not gather. A perceiving function — its feeder — has to deliver the experiences it weighs, and which one does the delivering changes what the weighing builds. Click a feeder to watch the nebula change shape and motion.
fi.zoneD.heading: The Verification Lab
fi.zoneD.lede: Watch Fi weigh experiences against its one inner standard in real time. Each button sends in a different kind of event — true joy, true grief, flattery, a violation — and the meters track what each one costs.
fi.zoneE.lede: Patterns from the wild — how Fi shows up in daily life.
